compound-interest-the-eighth-wonder-of-t.question: Compound interest means your gains can start earning money too.
compound-interest-the-eighth-wonder-of-t.why: That's the whole idea: returns get reinvested, so growth builds on growth instead of just on your original cash.

compound-interest-the-eighth-wonder-of-t.question: Two people invest the same total amount. Who usually ends up with more?
options: Whoever checked their account most often
compound-interest-the-eighth-wonder-of-t.why: More years of compounding matters more than most people expect, even when the total money in is identical.

index-funds-set-it-and-forget-it.question: What does an index fund actually do?
options: It tracks a list of stocks like the S&P 500
It guarantees you won't lose money
A manager picks the winners each week
It only invests in one company
index-funds-set-it-and-forget-it.why: It copies an existing list, so you own a sliver of everything on it instead of betting on one name.

index-funds-set-it-and-forget-it.question: If the whole market drops 10% in a month, an index fund will...
index-funds-set-it-and-forget-it.why: Diversification spreads your risk across many companies; it does not protect you from the whole market going down.

etfs-instant-diversification-made-easy.question: Buying one share of an ETF gives you...
options: A small piece of many holdings at once
etfs-instant-diversification-made-easy.why: An ETF bundles lots of investments into one tradable share, which is why it's an easy starter position.

etfs-instant-diversification-made-easy.question: How is an ETF different from a mutual fund in this practical way?
options: You can buy and sell it during the trading day
etfs-instant-diversification-made-easy.why: ETFs trade on an exchange like a stock, so you can transact any time the market is open.

what-is-the-s-p-500-and-why-should-you-c.question: The S&P 500 is...
options: A stock you can buy directly
A list of about 500 large US companies
what-is-the-s-p-500-and-why-should-you-c.why: It's an index, not a stock. You get exposure through a fund that tracks it.

what-is-the-s-p-500-and-why-should-you-c.question: Why do people quote the S&P 500 on the news?
options: It tracks the price of oil
It's a rough thermometer for big-company performance
It lists every stock ever traded
It sets the interest rate on loans
what-is-the-s-p-500-and-why-should-you-c.why: It covers a huge slice of the US market, so it works as a quick read on how large companies are doing overall.

market-orders-vs-limit-orders.question: You want to pay no more than $50 for a stock. Which order fits?
market-orders-vs-limit-orders.why: A limit order says 'this price or better' and simply won't fill above your number.

market-orders-vs-limit-orders.question: A market order guarantees you get the best possible price.
market-orders-vs-limit-orders.why: It guarantees speed, not price. You get whatever it costs right now, which can move against you between clicking and filling.

stock-splits-when-companies-multiply-you.question: In a 2-for-1 split, your 10 shares become 20. What happened to the value of what you own?
options: It depends on the company's mood
stock-splits-when-companies-multiply-you.why: Same pizza, more slices. Twice as many shares at roughly half the price each.

stock-splits-when-companies-multiply-you.question: A company does a stock split because its shares became popular enough that investors wanted them accessible.
stock-splits-when-companies-multiply-you.why: Lower headline prices make shares easier to buy in small sizes, but the company isn't worth more after splitting.

paper-trading-practice-without-risk.question: Paper trading means investing real money in low-risk stocks.
paper-trading-practice-without-risk.why: No real cash is involved. You track genuine market prices while practising decisions.

paper-trading-practice-without-risk.question: What's the main thing paper trading helps you build?
options: Better judgement before real money is at risk
paper-trading-practice-without-risk.why: You learn how your decisions behave without paying tuition to the market.

from-lemonade-stand-to-shareholder-under.question: Owning one share of a company makes you...
options: A creditor the company must repay
from-lemonade-stand-to-shareholder-under.why: Stock is equity. Even one share is a fractional claim on the business itself.

from-lemonade-stand-to-shareholder-under.question: If the company you own a share of does well, shareholders can benefit through...
options: Share price growth and sometimes dividends
from-lemonade-stand-to-shareholder-under.why: Owners get paid through rising value and profit distributions, not wages.

diversification-don-t-put-all-your-eggs-.question: Diversification mainly reduces...
options: The damage one bad investment can do
How long you have to wait to sell
diversification-don-t-put-all-your-eggs-.why: Spreading out means a single failure hurts less. It doesn't remove market-wide risk.

diversification-don-t-put-all-your-eggs-.question: Which portfolio is most diversified?
options: Ten shares of one sneaker company
Funds covering many industries and company sizes
diversification-don-t-put-all-your-eggs-.why: Diversification is about owning things that don't all sink together, not merely owning several tickers.

what-is-volatility-riding-the-roller-coa.question: A volatile stock is one that...
options: Moves up and down a lot
what-is-volatility-riding-the-roller-coa.why: Volatility measures how much the price swings, in either direction.

what-is-volatility-riding-the-roller-coa.question: Higher volatility automatically means higher returns over time.
what-is-volatility-riding-the-roller-coa.why: You're being exposed to more swing, not promised more reward. Bumpy can still go nowhere.
